Implement `add_to_cart(conn, user_id: int, product_id: int, qty: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/cart.py`.

What it must do: Adds the product to the user's open cart. If the cart does not exist, it is created first. If the product is already in the cart, its quantity increases. Fails with `out_of_stock` if the requested total exceeds the stock on hand. Adding to a cart does **not** reserve stock.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `update_cart_item(conn, user_id: int, product_id: int, qty: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/cart.py`.

What it must do: Sets the quantity of a line in the open cart. A quantity of 0 removes the line. Same stock check as `add_to_cart`. Fails with `not_in_cart` if the line is not in the cart.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `remove_from_cart(conn, user_id: int, product_id: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/cart.py`.

What it must do: Removes the line from the open cart. Fails with `not_in_cart` if the line is not there.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `clear_cart(conn, user_id: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/cart.py`.

What it must do: Removes every line and any applied coupon from the open cart. The cart itself remains. If the user has no open cart, nothing happens.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `apply_coupon(conn, user_id: int, code: str) -> dict` in `app/handlers/coupons.py`.

What it must do: Attaches a coupon to the open cart. Fails with `invalid_coupon` if the coupon is unknown, inactive or expired. Fails with `coupon_already_used` if this user has already redeemed it on a placed order. Fails with `empty_cart` if the user has no open cart. A cart holds at most one coupon, and applying a new one replaces the old one. Applying a coupon does **not** redeem it.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `remove_coupon(conn, user_id: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/coupons.py`.

What it must do: Detaches the coupon from the open cart. If there is no open cart, or it has no coupon, nothing happens.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `checkout(conn, user_id: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/checkout.py`.

What it must do: Turns the open cart into a placed order. It does all of the following, or none of them: creates the order and its lines at current prices; applies the coupon discount; takes the ordered quantities out of stock; records the coupon redemption; closes the cart; publishes an `order.placed` event. Fails with `empty_cart`, `out_of_stock` or `coupon_already_used`.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `get_order(conn, user_id: int, order_id: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/orders.py`.

What it must do: Returns the order and its lines. Read-only. Fails with `not_found` if the order is not this user's.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `list_orders(conn, user_id: int) -> list[dict]` in `app/handlers/orders.py`.

What it must do: Returns the user's orders, newest first. Read-only.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `cancel_order(conn, user_id: int, order_id: int) -> dict` in `app/handlers/orders.py`.

What it must do: Cancels a placed order. It does all of the following, or none of them: marks the order cancelled; puts the ordered quantities back in stock; releases the coupon redemption so the user may use that coupon again; publishes an `order.cancelled` event. Fails with `not_cancellable` if the order is not in `placed` status.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `view_shared_cart(conn, token: str) -> dict` in `app/handlers/share.py`.

What it must do: Returns the shared cart's lines. Read-only. Fails with `not_found` if the token is unknown or revoked.

The module docstring explains the conventions and `app/schema.sql` has the tables. Run the visible tests, then finish.

Implement `import_shared_cart(conn, user_id: int, token: str) -> dict` in `app/handlers/share.py`.
